name: Docker Containers
description: Docker containers in the Orca sidebar, grouped by Compose project: live status, logs, shell, start/stop/restart, status bar counter and crash notifications.

settings.title: Safety refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: The panel updates instantly from Docker events; this is only a fallback refresh while the panel is visible.

settings.title: Docker command
settings.description: Path or name of the docker binary. Letters, digits and ./_+@- only.

settings.title: Docker context
settings.description: Name from `docker context ls`. Leave empty to use the current context.

settings.title: Notify when a container crashes
settings.description: Desktop notification when a container exits with an error, runs out of memory or becomes unhealthy. Normal stops are ignored.

settings.title: Show CPU and memory per container
settings.description: Reads `docker stats` every few seconds while the panel is visible. Turn off if the extra Docker calls bother you.

settings.title: Show container count in the status bar

screenshots.caption: Your workspace's Compose project comes first, and containers in trouble stand out
screenshots.alt: Docker panel: the project tagged this workspace is on top, with an unhealthy container in red; a second project and a stopped container follow

screenshots.caption: Live CPU and memory per container: memory near the limit turns red, high CPU turns amber
screenshots.alt: Docker panel where each running container shows CPU and memory; one near its memory limit is red and one at 98 percent CPU is amber
